mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( user_id, total_price, status, ordered_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, total_price AS totalPrice, status, ordered_at AS orderedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}
